info.name: Veyro API
info.description: Run Auth > Login first: it stores {{token}}. Admin requests need a user with role ADMIN.

item.name: Reset password (put real token from email)

exec: pm.test("200 with real token, 400 with placeholder", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 400]));
pm.test("authors are masked", () => j.items.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.user && r.user.email || "").to.not.include("@")));
pm.test("201 buyer / 403 no paid order / 409 duplicate", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 403, 409]));
pm.test("201 ok, 409 not pending, 503 Stripe not configured/unavailable", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201, 409, 503]));
pm.test("has new routes", () => { const p = pm.response.json().paths; pm.expect(p).to.have.property("/auth/forgot-password"); pm.expect(p).to.have.property("/orders/{id}/pay"); });
